# ProblemDetails

RFC 9457 Problem Details for HTTP APIs — Standard error response format. Extension members (code, timestamp, traceId, errors) are permitted per §3.1.

Name | Type | Description | Notes
------------ | ------------- | ------------- | -------------
**type** | **str** | URI reference identifying the problem type (§3.1.1) | 
**title** | **str** | Short, human-readable summary of the problem type (§3.1.2) | 
**status** | **int** | HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence (§3.1.3) | 
**detail** | **str** | Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence (§3.1.4) | [optional] 
**instance** | **str** | URI reference identifying the specific occurrence of the problem (§3.1.5) | [optional] 
**code** | **str** | Machine-readable error code for frontend error message mapping | [optional] 
**timestamp** | **datetime** | Timestamp when the error occurred (ISO 8601 format) | [optional] 
**trace_id** | **str** | Unique trace ID for debugging and log correlation | [optional] 
**errors** | [**List[ValidationError]**](ValidationError.md) | Field-level validation errors (for 400 Bad Request responses) | [optional]
